title: 'Legend replaces a Legend': Trump wants Tim Cook to replace Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
summary_full: In light of Jensen Huang's sudden resignation from Nvidia, alleged personal conduct issues have arisen. Donald Trump has proposed Tim Cook as a fitting successor. The Nvidia board swiftly acknowledged Huang's significant contributions while confirming his departure. Consequently, Nvidia experienced a substantial stock decline. Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO as the company begins its search for a permanent replacement.
